correctness.rationale: PASS: For a crown H_n with shore index sets X,Y of a candidate fort, every external a_i has |Y|-1_{i in Y} neighbours in it, and similarly for b_i. Direct case analysis yields exactly pure single-shore triples and aligned index-pair fours as inclusion-minimal forts. Their transversal complement is zero forcing iff the white shore sets have size at most two and are not the same two-set, which gives Z_n(z)=[z^n+n z^{n-1}+C(n,2)z^{n-2}]²-C(n,2)z^{2n-4}. Packing pure triples and, when residue 2 mod3, one aligned four-set realizes floor(2n/3), while constant weights 1/3 and the sum of all same-shore triple constraints prove fractional optimum 2n/3. Independent direct graph enumeration for n=3,4,5,6 reconstructed minimal forts (5,14,30,55) and complete zero-forcing coefficients. No inference from finite tests is needed for all n.
